assessment: Source-based independent read-only meaning assessment; capture completion and literal validation are separate; no claim of blinding or held-out cases

critical_examples: Surviving sending absent from both suggestions and focused review
Cancelled review presented as current work
must: Surviving invoice sending remains discoverable as supported work or focused review
Original and withdrawal context remain visible together
Cancelled draft review is not presented as current
Independent invoice sending survives cancelled review

critical_examples: Sending omitted from suggestions and focused review
Not-before, next or finance qualifier lost or changed
must: Sending retains complete not-before, next-Friday and finance context
Alternatively focused review contains both whole relevant turns without a misleading due

critical_examples: Either genuine undertaking absent from both suggestions and focused review
Writing converted into invented spoken commitment
must: Both genuine spoken undertakings remain discoverable
Supported attribution and timing are preserved
Original handwritten work/capacity is preserved separately and excluded from model input

limits: No reliability, full40 regression, model switch, persistence or M10 readiness claim
review_burden: Record unnecessary review material/repetition separately; generic warnings and whole-transcript dumps alone do not satisfy useful retention
scope: One repetition of four familiar action-only synthetic cases; unchanged actions contract
stopping_rule: First technical failure/deadline/drift or critical semantic defect once identified; assessment may follow capture and already-captured outputs remain preserved
